description: Roll back an agent run by replaying agents.action_journal in reverse from latest step down to ?to_seq=N. Invokes per-action_type compensation handlers. Returns RollbackSummary. AC-8. A freshly-started run has an empty action_journal, so rollback returns 200 with attempted=0.

testCases.name: Roll back a freshly-started run (empty action journal) returns 200

errorCases.when: No Authorization: Bearer <jwt> header on a requireAuth route
Bearer token fails verifyJwt (bad signature, malformed, or exp in the past)
The :run_id path segment resolves to an empty value
The to_seq query param is present but is not parseable as an integer, or parses to a value below -1
rollbackRun throws — the run does not exist, a compensation handler fails, or the database is unreachable. Note this handler has no 404 branch, so an unknown run_id surfaces as 500
